name: Gourmet Bagel Deli
reason: Couldn't find a place by this name in Point Loma or anywhere in San Diego after 3 searches (not closed or a chain, just not found). Closest matches: The Gourmet Bagger (sandwich shop since 1990, 3357 Rosecrans St) and P.L. Bagels (3704 Voltaire St). Tell me which one you meant and I'll research it.

name: The Tin Scoop
reason: Closed: its listing (The Tin Scoop Cafe, 639 Kettner Blvd, Downtown) is marked closed as of May 2026, and we found no new location. It was a cafe on Kettner rather than a Marina District kiosk; if you know a separate kiosk, tell me where.

name: La Fachada
reason: Closed or closing: SanDiegoVille (Feb 11, 2026) reported the 1992 Logan Heights taqueria would close over a lease dispute, a lawsuit and a split between the owner brothers. No sign it survived; skip unless you know it is open.

name: Ali Baba Family Restaurant
reason: Likely closed: its main listing (421 E Main St, El Cajon) is marked closed as of 2026. Delivery apps still show it, so worth a call if you want it back.

name: Earlybird
reason: Poor fit: a breakfast-burrito stall inside the Mission + Garnet food hall in Pacific Beach, not a standalone place with its own story.

name: Bahn Thai
reason: Poor fit: a well-liked 2011 neighborhood Thai restaurant with two locations and nothing distinctive found. It also moved to 4628 Park Blvd.

name: Tacaliente Mexican Grill
reason: Poor fit: a modern Hillcrest taqueria; no history or standout dish found beyond one breakfast-burrito list mention.
